vocab.title: Match each expression to its meaning
defs: planting trees again on land where the forest was cut down
using land, water and people in a way that can continue for decades
the system that lets one company pay for a reduction made somewhere else
a contract in which the state lets a company use public land or a public service
the official paper that allows an activity the law would otherwise forbid
one tonne of carbon dioxide that was not released, sold as a unit
to check something against a standard and give it an official document
the whole set of rules that govern an activity in a country

items.situation: Somebody asks what you do, in one sentence.
tips: I am the legal manager who handles contracts, litigation and advisory work for an agribusiness group.
Lesson 1: one long sentence with who or that, not three short ones.

items.situation: They ask how long you have been in the role.
tips: I have been the legal manager since twenty twenty-one, and I joined the group in twenty sixteen.
Lesson 2: since for the open period, past simple for the closed date.

items.situation: In a meeting: what has your team been doing this week?
tips: We have been reviewing the supply contracts since Monday, and we have not finished yet.
Lesson 3: the week takes have been + ing.

items.situation: The commercial team asks what happens if the buyer signs on Friday.
tips: If they sign on Friday, the first shipment will leave in three weeks.
Lesson 4: real and likely, and no will after if.

items.situation: They ask you to accept a liability cap you cannot accept.
tips: If we capped our liability there, a quality problem would cost us far more than you could claim.
Lesson 4: refuse the idea by showing the consequence.

items.situation: A colleague from the new company asks: "So what is a carbon credit, exactly?"
tips: It is one tonne of carbon dioxide that was not released, sold as a unit.
Say it in one sentence, the way you would to somebody who is not a lawyer.

listenings.text: Amanda, it is Karin again, from risk. Two things before you go. First, well done on the supply contract. The final version came back with the annual cap and one and a half per cent, which is exactly what we asked for, and the finance director noticed. Second, and this is the reason I am calling. The group has bought a stake in a reforestation project in the north, and legal has to look at it. It is a concession agreement with the state, it runs for thirty years, and the whole value of the project depends on carbon credits that a certification body still has to approve. Nobody here has done this before, including me. I have sent you the framework document. Read the first ten pages and tell me on Monday what worries you most. Thank you, Amanda.

Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the opening session. Before the technical part, a short introduction for those of you who are new to this market. A carbon credit is a unit. One credit is one tonne of carbon dioxide that was not released into the atmosphere, or that was taken out of it. Somebody has to certify that the tonne is real, and that is the job of an independent verification body. The activity behind the credit can be many things, but in this region it is usually reforestation, because the land is there and the trees do the work. The legal part matters more than people expect. Most of these projects sit on a concession agreement with the state, which means that for the next thirty years two parties have to keep a promise about the same piece of land. Every lawyer in this room knows what that means.

extra_audio.text: Say who you are and what your team handles. Then say how long you have been there and where you started. Then say what you have been working on this month. Then say what will happen if the current project goes through. And finally, say what would happen if it did not, and what you would do about it.
